constraints: For a new (not-yet-saved) record, Old returns the default empty value for the field's type (e.g. empty string for Alpha, zero for numeric).
For Picture and BLOB type fields, the value returned by Old cannot be used directly as a parameter to another command for technical reasons; it must first be assigned to an intermediate variable.
To restore a field's original (on-disk) value, assign it the value returned by Old.
